data.description:
# Tests: activity-log coverage for enriched entries + net row

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F1 — test-first verification slice, parent AC5 tests part).

## Goal

Extend `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` to assert the enriched entry formats (cost + effective deltas) and the per-turn net summary row, establishing the expected formats before implementation; update any existing assertions that match old entry text.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` asserts enriched entry text (cost + effective coin/rep deltas) and `gain|loss|neutral` type for: played event from hand, business purchase, community-space purchase, upgrade purchase, buy-and-place (incl. premium), hand and slot sell, community favour exchange, re-roll market, staff hire/layoff, staff/community/business ongoing costs, income phase (incl. negative income), incident resolution.
- AC2: Net-row presence + format (`Turn N net: ...`) asserted for a full turn, incl. the zero-net case and the parent-AC3-defined early game-over behaviour.
- AC3: Existing assertions matching the pre-change entry text are updated to the new canonical formats in the same change.
- AC4: `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` passes; no other unit tests regress (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/`).

- Traceability: implements parent AC5 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC5 — Tests and docs.** `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` extended
## Minimal Implementation

- Scripted-turn fixtures with known deltas (reuse existing test helpers in `tests/main-street/`).
- Assert exact substrings built from the shared `describeEventEffects` style (`+3 coins, +2 rep`); assert `Turn N net: ...` placement/format.
- Update any tests asserting old entry text as part of this change so the suite defines the contract first (red → green as F2-F4 implement).

## Key Files

- tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts
- tests/main-street/activity-log-rendering.test.ts (verify only, no accept-format changes here)

## Constraints

- Expected formats derive from the parent brief (AC1/AC2/AC3): entries keep existing substrings (name, slot, €cost); net row emitted even when net is zero.
- Structured transcript recording (`recordMainStreetEvent`) is outside this item's scope.
